newsitem.title: USA: Cypress Semi sees revenue growth in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Cypress Semi sees revenue growth in Q3.

text.p: Cypress Semiconductor Corp Chief Executive Officer T.J. Rodgers said Tuesday that bookings were strong for most of the second quarter and orders exceeded shipments by a comfortable margin, making revenue growth reasonably certain for the third quarter.
Cypress today reported second quarter revenue rose to $138.1 million from the first quarter's $126.0 million and the year-earlier $135.5 million.
Earnings were $0.07 per share, up from the first quarter's $0.06 but down from year-earlier fully diluted earnings of $0.20 per share.
